package.description: An ad-free YouTube Music desktop player with offline downloads, synced lyrics and a 10-band equalizer.

en-US.description: An ad-free YouTube Music desktop player with offline downloads, synced lyrics and a 10-band equalizer.
en-US.longDescription:
Verza Next is a desktop player for YouTube Music. It plays audio only, without video or ads,
and adds the things a music app is expected to have: offline downloads, time-synced lyrics,
a 10-band equalizer with presets, crossfade, volume normalization, a sleep timer, global
media hotkeys and Windows media controls.

Its home page is built from what you actually listen to rather than an editorial feed, and
"Your Sound" works out the genres behind your listening and builds radio stations from them.
The window is translucent, with a liquid-glass look that picks up the colour of the album art.

Verza Next is unofficial and is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
en-US.name: Verza Next
